---
title: "What is really driving monetary policy?"
date: "2019-10-16"
categories: ["Monetary Policy"]
---

I get a mention in this insightful column by [Parnell McGuinness](https://www.afr.com/policy/economy/what-is-really-driving-monetary-policy-20191015-p530qp) noting that the debate over monetary policy is really about the allocation of responsibility for macroeconomic policy. RBA needs to step-up, not deflect.
